name: a2ai-community
description: Community-contributed skills for the 8020brain template, built by Ads to AI members.

plugins.name: google-ads-pmax-asset-group-creator
plugins.description: Create a new asset group inside an existing Performance Max campaign through the Google Ads API, guided one step at a time. Checks character limits before the API call, reuses the campaign's existing audience signals and brand logo, and comes out paused and dry-run by default. Python skill (needs Python and the google-ads library).

plugins.name: seo-council-eval
plugins.description: A council of named-lens SEO experts scores one page against a six-dimension rubric (entity and semantic coverage, GEO/AEO retrieval, search intent, E-E-A-T, on-page mechanics, strategic fit) and returns a ranked fix list with a verdict of ship, fix-then-ship, or rework. Each dimension is scored by a separate agent so disagreements are discovered rather than authored, with two readers on search intent because it carries the most weight. A mandatory attribution gate keeps the named practitioners represented as analytical lenses, never as if they reviewed the page.

plugins.name: google-ads-auction-insights
plugins.description: Consolidates Google Ads Auction Insights scheduled reports into a hub sheet and builds an interactive competitor dashboard, one tab per report, plus periodic auction alerts and a staleness tripwire that catches a frozen scheduled report. Handles English and Italian reports, dot or comma decimals, with 24 tests and a bundled sample report.

plugins.name: brain-full-audit
plugins.description: Full audit of your brain build across eight dimensions: security, cost, efficiency, structure, reliability, privacy, rule compliance, and design quality. Scored report, nothing changes until you approve.

plugins.name: sellable-ada-audit
plugins.description: Audit a website for ADA compliance against WCAG 2.1 AA. Automated checks plus screenshot and HTML review, scored report with legal risk level and developer-ready fixes. Built to sell as a client service.

plugins.name: threshold-recommender
plugins.description: Interactive Shopping Threshold Recommender for Google Ads. Product-level bucketing with adjustable ROAS/CPA sliders and AI recommendations.

plugins.name: budget-guardian
plugins.description: Monitors a Google Ads MCC for monthly budget overruns and sends Slack alerts at 100% and 120% of monthly budget per account. Alert-only, never pauses campaigns.

plugins.name: microsoft-ads
plugins.description: v2 rewrite on the Microsoft Advertising REST API v13 (SOAP retired): campaigns, search terms, conversions, conversion goals, UET tags, and reporting.

plugins.name: bucket-list
plugins.description: Track bucket list experiences, festivals, and natural phenomena with auto-enrichment via web research.

plugins.name: e2e-qa-testing
plugins.description: Automated E2E QA testing for Next.js apps using Playwright.

plugins.name: mutation-safety
plugins.description: Mandatory safety system that enforces two-step approval for all Google Ads mutations and destructive Google Sheets operations.

plugins.name: home-repair-funds
plugins.description: Homeowner sinking-fund planner. Tracks major home systems with install dates, lifespans, and replacement costs. Calculates weekly savings split across HYSA + brokerage.

plugins.name: website-builder-pack
plugins.description: Ten skills that take you from a blank folder to a launch-ready WordPress site with Claude Code and Local WP. Site planning, theme scaffolding, page building, copywriting, SEO/AEO, security and production audits, and a pre-launch checklist.
